equation.exposition_role: Compute monetary purchasing-power loss for the constant-exposure case.
equation.symbols_units_domain: M and L_mon are local-currency amounts; the index ratio is dimensionless and the loss is in closing purchasing-power units.
equation.assumptions_timing: Cash 100, fixed nominal debt 80, no transactions/interest/tax/impairment, and an index rise from 100 to 150.
equation.source_and_equality: M(I1/I0−1)=(100−80)(1.5−1)=10, matching cash loss 50 less debt gain 40.
equation.interpretation: Positive means loss; a net monetary liability reverses the sign, and equal indices give zero.
equation.transition: The exposure-changing example splits the history at the cash receipt rather than reusing this constant-M shortcut.
